The maximum distance from the origin to the disk is the distance to its center plus the radius:
\[
\sqrt{\left(\frac12\right)^2+\left(\frac12\right)^2}+\frac{\sqrt2}{2}
=\frac{\sqrt2}{2}+\frac{\sqrt2}{2}
=\sqrt2.
\]
Thus the maximum value of \(x^2+y^2\) is
\[
(\sqrt2)^2=2.
\]
So the minimum possible \(k\) is

\[
\boxed{2}.
\]
